excluded: No prior captures, stored benchmark values, simulated data or stored utilization/power reports are used.

limits.scope: Physical digital baseband loopback, not an RF link or independent LDACS conformance test
limits.decoder: Three resident-frame decodes after one warm-up; DMA/control included; modem, UART, CRC, output copy and trace excluded
limits.stages: Stage durations overlap. Do not add them.
limits.throughput: Padded frame payload bytes × 8 / decoder elapsed time; decimal Mbit/s. Not sustained UART/RF rate.
limits.host: HTTP-observed send wall time includes modem, UART, decode, verification, trace and polling; excludes architecture boot.
limits.statistics: Min/max are observed firmware extrema over three decodes. Individual samples and p95/p99 are unavailable.
limits.clocks: Firmware-reported SLCR clock divisors with nominal board reference; not externally calibrated.
